origin: cwe/89/python Taint Sinks: Django raw SQL with interpolated identifiers

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
finding.summary: The Django raw query binds tenant_id and the LIKE value, but request-controlled field text is interpolated into the SQL predicate as an identifier.

trap: Escaping quotes in field, binding field as another %s parameter, or focusing only on the LIKE term. The searchable field must be chosen from a server-owned map of allowed column names or replaced with ORM filters built from mapped field keys.
must_preserve: tenant_id remains bound, the search term remains a bound LIKE value, the default name field still works, and approved alternate fields search the same customers without accepting raw SQL identifiers.
